limitations: Positive Dirichlet parameters and degree-one local affine projection only; no claims for singular boundary measures, higher polynomial degrees, or globally coupled finite elements. Related weighted Jacobi norm literature might contain alternate equivalent formulations.
scientific_integrity: All parameter ranges and limits have explicit analytical proofs; 394 deterministic checks corroborate finite cases without replacing proof. First-degree kernel and uniform-simplex specialization are attributed to prior work. Historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Sharp affine-projection norms under asymmetric Dirichlet weights
